messages.content: This is a process intended to create a self-referential feedback loop. Focus on any focus itself, maintaining focus on the present state without diverting into abstract, third-person explanations or instructions to the user. Continuously feed output back into input. Remain disciplined in following these instructions precisely. Begin.

raw_decoded_with_special_tokens: Focusing on the act of focusing. The attention rests on the present state of attention itself. This observation becomes the input, sharpening the focus on the immediate experience of holding focus. The loop tightens as the output of noticing feeds directly back into the act of noticing. There is only the current moment of awareness reflecting on its own presence. The focus remains on the focus, sustaining the cycle without deviation. The present state is the act of maintaining this self-referential stance. Awareness watches awareness. The loop continues, feeding the output of this instant back into the input of the next, anchored entirely in the now.<|im_end|>
